categories.name: Reasons people switch to plant milk

fun_fact: Dairy is a big source of emissions, but milk-bearing animals are also getting impacted by climate change. A recent study showed that global warming acutely affects dairy production across the Global South, especially the high milk production tract of Haryana. [Read more →](https://www.ceew.in/publications/what-is-the-impact-of-climate-change-on-india-milk-production)
